mode.title: Run Mode
mode.description: daily / historical = PropertyRadar list pulls (requires pr_username + pr_password). chesterfield-code-violation = Chesterfield ACA bulk code violation report (anonymous). richmond-vacant = Richmond Vacant Building List vacancy registry (anonymous). va-public-notice = Virginia Press Association notices (estate/foreclosure/tax-deed); requires vapn_username + vapn_password + captcha_api_key. The chesterfield + richmond modes do NOT need credentials.

vapn_username.title: VA Public Notice Email (va-public-notice only)
vapn_username.description: Login email for the free Virginia Press Association Smart Search account (publicnoticevirginia.com/SmartSearchSignup.aspx). Required for va-public-notice mode.

vapn_password.title: VA Public Notice Password (va-public-notice only)
vapn_password.description: Login password for the VPA Smart Search account. Required for va-public-notice mode.

captcha_api_key.title: 2Captcha API Key (va-public-notice only)
captcha_api_key.description: 2Captcha key for solving the reCAPTCHA v2 on VPA notice detail pages (~$2.99/1000 solves). Required for va-public-notice mode.

va_mode.title: VA Public Notice Pull Mode (va-public-notice only)
va_mode.description: daily = notices since last run (delta). historical = last 12 months. Daily-cadence recommended.

va_since.title: VA Public Notice Since-Date Override (va-public-notice only)
va_since.description: Override the since-date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to use state (last run date) / 7-day first-run window.

pr_username.title: PropertyRadar Email
pr_username.description: Login email for app.propertyradar.com (Solo plan). Required for daily / historical modes only.

pr_password.title: PropertyRadar Password
pr_password.description: Login password for app.propertyradar.com. Required for daily / historical modes only.

aca_start.title: ACA Date Window Start (chesterfield-code-violation only)
aca_start.description: Override the start date for the Chesterfield ACA report (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to let the puller decide based on state (yesterday-to-today after first run, 90-day window first time).

aca_end.title: ACA Date Window End (chesterfield-code-violation only)
aca_end.description: Override the end date for the Chesterfield ACA report (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank for today.

aca_first_pull_days.title: ACA First-Pull Window Size (days)
aca_first_pull_days.description: How many days back to fetch on the first-ever ACA pull (no prior state). Default 90.

aca_all_violations.title: ACA: include ALL code violations (bypass high-motivation filter)
aca_all_violations.description: Default OFF. When OFF, only Chesterfield cases citing a HIGH_MOTIVATION_CODE_SECTIONS pattern (currently 'vacant') are emitted as leads. Filter source-of-truth: src/chesterfield_aca_puller.py. When ON, every code violation case is emitted.

use_residential_proxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
use_residential_proxy.description: Route requests through Apify residential proxies to avoid IP blocks.

google_drive_folder_id.title: Google Drive Folder ID
google_drive_folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID for CSV upload. Leave empty to skip Drive upload.

google_service_account_key.title: Google Service Account Key (base64)
google_service_account_key.description: Base64-encoded JSON key for the Google service account. Required if google_drive_folder_id is set.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API Key
anthropic_api_key.description: API key for Claude Haiku LLM parsing. Used by the obituary enricher and the VA public-notice LLM parser. Optional but recommended.

smarty_auth_id.title: Smarty Auth ID
smarty_auth_id.description: Auth ID from smarty.com for USPS address standardization (geocoding, vacancy detection, ZIP+4). Optional.

smarty_auth_token.title: Smarty Auth Token
smarty_auth_token.description: Auth token from smarty.com (paired with Auth ID). Required if smarty_auth_id is set.

openwebninja_api_key.title: OpenWeb Ninja API Key (Zillow Enrichment)
openwebninja_api_key.description: API key from openwebninja.com for the Real-Time Zillow Data API. Enriches with MLS status, Zestimate, property type. Free tier: 100 requests/month.

serper_api_key.title: Serper.dev API Key
serper_api_key.description: API key from serper.dev for Google Search. Used for DM address lookup via people-search sites. Free tier: 2,500 queries.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API Key
firecrawl_api_key.description: API key from firecrawl.dev for JS-rendered page scraping. Used for DM address extraction from people-search sites. Free tier: 500 pages.

tracerfy_api_key.title: Tracerfy API Key
tracerfy_api_key.description: API key from tracerfy.com for skip tracing. $0.02/record. Optional.

trestle_api_key.title: Trestle API Key
trestle_api_key.description: API key from trestleiq.com for phone validation scoring. Assigns 5-tier dial priority. Optional.

datasift_email.title: DataSift Email
datasift_email.description: Login email for DataSift.ai (app.reisift.io). Required for automatic CRM upload.

datasift_password.title: DataSift Password
datasift_password.description: Login password for DataSift.ai. Required for automatic CRM upload.

slack_webhook_url.title: Slack/Discord Webhook URL
slack_webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for run summary notifications. Works with Slack incoming webhooks or Discord /slack endpoints.

upload_datasift.title: Upload to DataSift
upload_datasift.description: Automatically upload enriched records to DataSift.ai CRM after the run. Requires datasift_email and datasift_password.

enrich_datasift.title: Enrich in DataSift
enrich_datasift.description: Run DataSift's Enrich Property Information (SiftMap) after upload.

skip_trace_datasift.title: Skip Trace in DataSift
skip_trace_datasift.description: Run DataSift's built-in Skip Trace after upload.

run_tracerfy.title: Run Tracerfy Skip Trace
run_tracerfy.description: Run Tracerfy batch skip trace before DataSift upload. Requires tracerfy_api_key.

notify_slack.title: Send Slack Notification
notify_slack.description: Send a run summary to Slack/Discord after the pipeline completes. Requires slack_webhook_url.

include_vacant.title: Include Vacant Land
include_vacant.description: Keep vacant land parcels. Default OFF.

include_entities.title: Include Entity-Owned Properties
include_entities.description: Keep LLC/Corp/Trust-owned records without filtering. Default OFF.
